title: Ning Li's last talk was at a MITRE conference before she went black

tellings.quote: Ning Lee was last you know speaking at a meer conference before she kind of went into the black

plain: A scientist named Ning Li is said to have given her last public talk at a conference held by MITRE, a research organisation that does work for the US government, before she "kind of went into the black," meaning she disappeared into secret government work. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and it matters because it would suggest her research was taken behind closed doors.
